about: What changed in Umbryx, newest first. The Home screen of the website and the desktop app shows the first three. Add an entry for every update.

updates.title: The website matches the app
added: The website has the app's column on the left: Home for friends and messages, then the server.
Umbryx opens on Home, with your friends and messages, instead of the last channel.
Right-click anyone's name for a quick menu: profile, message, call, friends.
Admins can remove someone from the server (right-click, Kick from server). A new invite code lets them back.
This panel: what changed in the last three updates.
The top bar shows how many tokens building Umbryx has taken so far, what they would cost, and which Claude model is doing the work.
Give your friends nicknames only you see: they show on your friends list as "Nickname (username)".
The message box is ready as soon as you open a channel or DM: just start typing, no click needed.
Settings works like Discord's: change something and a bar asks you to save or reset; voice and video settings apply straight away.
Hover over a server, Home or someone in the column on the left to see their name.
Hover over a badge to see its name and why it was given, or over the check beside a partnered server's name, in a bubble pointing at it.
Hover over a partnered server in the column on the left and its name shows with the partner check.
Double-click someone's message to reply to it (double-clicking your own still edits it).
A small icon after someone's name shows what they're on: the desktop app, the website or their phone.
Invite links: admins copy a link like us.vlcno.xyz/K7QM2XPA, and opening it fills in the code for you.
Close a direct message with the ✕ on its row: it leaves your list until one of you writes again.
Admins can server mute, server deafen and ban people from the menu on their name; Server settings lists the bans.
Post an invite link in a chat and it shows a card with the server and a Join button, like Discord.
Passkeys: sign in with your face, fingerprint or PIN. Add one in Settings, under Profile.
Skip for now is gone: everyone makes an account. An invite code is still optional.
Calls are for friends only, and calling a friend who's offline rings anyway: on their phone, and when they open Umbryx. A call they missed is waiting for them.
Right-click a text channel to choose its notifications: All messages, Only @mentions or Nothing. It follows you to every device and your phone.
When someone joins the server, a welcome line shows in the first channel, like "Nite_Quest joined the party."
fixed: Chats stay at the newest message instead of drifting up.
The emoji picker opens straight away instead of after several seconds.
Picture strength under Appearance reaches the real 100%.
Settings no longer pile up on each other in a small window.
Pressing Enter in Settings no longer signs you out, and Sign out asks first.
Right-clicking anyone, anywhere they show, opens their menu; the browser's own menu no longer pops up.
Pressing Enter in a box in Settings, or any other window, saves it instead of doing nothing.
Friends rows are tidier: nickname and remove friend live in the right-click menu.
Settings no longer leaves a big gap above the App card: each column stacks its cards.
In a direct message, @ only suggests the two of you.
Only the server's admins can make, rename or delete channels.

updates.title: Invite codes and guests
added: Skip for now: try Umbryx without an account, and message and call your friends.
New accounts start in direct messages until someone gives them an invite code. Admins make codes in Server settings.
Delete your own account in Settings. Your messages stay, shown as Deleted user.
Umbryx Staff can delete other people's accounts from their profile.
fixed: The member list no longer stays on screen on Friends and in direct messages.
Signing out leaves a clean sign-in screen, with nothing of your account showing.
The server's name and picture stay hidden until you are signed in and in the server.
Badges show on profiles only, no longer next to names.
Guests are told why they cannot add custom emoji.

updates.title: Activity, nameplates and badges
added: Show the game you are playing and what you are listening to on Spotify (desktop app).
Animated nameplates behind your name, or your own picture or clip.
New badges: Umbryx Staff, Server Owner, Early Supporter and Umbryx Partner.
YouTube and X links show previews you can play and read in the chat.
Display names, and stronger noise suppression for your microphone.
fixed: Clicking a notification opens that conversation.
Restarting to update puts you back in your voice channel.
Joining voice no longer mutes you.
The Windows taskbar shows the Umbryx icon.
